cues: Early on, both daughter cells keep dividing, so growth is geometric: exponential.
Later, only one daughter keeps dividing while the other differentiates, so growth becomes arithmetic, a straight line.
Fast, then steady, then flat: the S.
text: Why an S? Early on, both daughter cells keep dividing, so growth is geometric: exponential. Later, only one daughter keeps dividing while the other differentiates, so growth becomes arithmetic, a straight line. Then it stops. Fast, then steady, then flat: the S.
